description: Grandfathered native browser `title=` tooltips (per-file counts) in ui/src, excluding __tests__. Enforced by ui/src/__tests__/nativeTooltipCompliance.test.ts as a ratchet: a file may never exceed its count, and the entry must be lowered when the code is cleaned. New UI must use the React <Tooltip> component from ui/src/frontend/shell/Tooltip.tsx instead (fit="inline" for toolbar buttons/badges so the wrapper does not stretch them). `title` alongside `pattern` is exempt — that is HTML5 constraint-validation messaging, not a hover affordance. Do not add files to this list.
